name: Ziza
overview: Ziza was a male member of the tribe of Simeon, identified specifically as the son of Shiphi. He is noted in Scripture as a Simeonite, indicating his tribal affiliation within Israel. Beyond this, there is limited additional information about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Ziza appears as a proper name and is described as a childish abbreviation or term of endearment, similar to 'mama.' This suggests the name may have been used affectionately, though it was not given by God.
familyAndRelationships: Ziza is explicitly recorded as the son of Shiphi, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented in Scripture for him beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ziza's mention in Scripture serves to preserve the genealogical records of the tribe of Simeon, highlighting the continuity of Israel's tribal families. His identification as Shiphi's son situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's descendants, emphasizing the importance of lineage in God's covenant people. Although not prominent in major events, his record contributes to the comprehensive biblical account of Israel's tribes.
